patch_description:
The current ansatz uses 7 distinct parameters with symmetric entanglement (nearest-neighbor XX, selective YY and ZZ on diagonals). To improve worst-group margin (the dominant scoring term), I will enhance the entanglement layer with:

1. Additional long-range XX gates connecting qubit pairs that were previously unentangled (e.g., [1,5], [2,6], [3,7])
2. More diverse entanglement by adding complementary pairs with YY and ZZ
3. Strategic parameter reuse to keep parameter economy tight while dramatically expanding the entanglement graph

This creates richer feature space from the measurements without increasing parameter count significantly, which should help the classifier separate hard samples better. The key insight: more diverse entanglement paths = more expressive correlator patterns = better worst-case margin.
